output.patientMessage: A Counsel clinician can take this up in this thread to arrange the right STI tests and timing for you; there's no rush since you report no symptoms. Testing is worthwhile because many STIs cause no symptoms. If you develop discharge, genital sores, pelvic or abdominal pain, painful urination, or fever, seek clinical care promptly rather than waiting for testing.
